entries.authorizer: SENTINEL (REPAIR-DEV-01 adjudication; Validation AUTHORIZED with freeze directives)
entries.reason: Mechanical arm-neutral classification of provider failures for paired comparisons. INFRA = provider_timeout (status_code==0 AND empty text; llm_service.py:300-309, covers timeout :240 / connection :248 / request exception :256) OR provider_api_error (status not in (0,200); llm_service.py:285-297, covers HTTP 429/5xx).
